notes: No SVG of the app mark exists: Giftbit's only vectors are the 'giftbit' wordmark (Giftbit/Giftbit-API-Docs mintlify/logo/light.svg, dark.svg; downloads/giftbit/src4). This 180px PNG is crisp and 3.75x the current 48px file. DECISION: the favicon everywhere else is the same 'g' on a shaded sphere, not a square; this mask icon is the square iOS version, whose highlight runs into a near-white top-left corner (faint on the light well). If the reviewer prefers the sphere: the crisp copy is only 72px (www.giftbit.com 'Favicon 72x72.webp', downloads/giftbit/p3-1), and docs.giftbit.com's 180px apple-touch-icon.png (downloads/giftbit/p3-2) is a soft Mintlify upscale of it.
